mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time, t.start_time, t.end_time, -- 计算是否逾期： -- 1. 没有计划结束时间：不算逾期 -- 2. 已完成（status=4）：比较实际完成时间(end_time)和计划结束时间 -- 3. 未完成：比较当前时间和计划结束时间 CASE WHEN t.plan_end_time IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN CASE WHEN t.end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.end_time > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END WHEN NOW() > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_overdue, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, t.project_id, -- 负责人信息（taskRole = 1 表示负责人） owner_su.user_id AS owner_user_id, owner_su.avatar AS owner_avatar, owner_su.nick_name AS owner_nick_name FROM task t -- 关联负责人 LEFT JOIN task_user owner_tu ON owner_tu.task_id = t.id AND owner_tu.task_role = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user owner_su ON owner_su.user_id = owner_tu.user_id AND owner_su.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.del_flag = 0

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.avatar AS avatar, su.nick_name AS nickName FROM task_user tu INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = tu.user_id AND su.del_flag = 0 WHERE tu.task_id = #{id} AND tu.task_role = 2 ORDER BY tu.create_time ASC

SELECT tr.id, tr.task_id, tr.operator_id, tr.action_type, tr.remark, tr.create_time, su.nick_name AS operator_name, su.avatar AS operator_avatar FROM task_record tr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = tr.operator_id AND su.del_flag = 0 WHERE tr.task_id = #{id} ORDER BY tr.create_time DESC
SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, record_id AS recordId, file_name AS fileName, file_url AS fileUrl FROM task_attachment WHERE record_id = #{id} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time, -- 计算是否逾期： -- 1. 没有计划结束时间：不算逾期 -- 2. 已完成（status=4）：比较实际完成时间(end_time)和计划结束时间 -- 3. 未完成：比较当前时间和计划结束时间 CASE WHEN t.plan_end_time IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN CASE WHEN t.end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.end_time > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END WHEN NOW() > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_overdue, t.remark, -- 负责人信息（taskRole = 1 表示负责人） owner_su.user_id AS owner_user_id, owner_su.avatar AS owner_avatar, owner_su.nick_name AS owner_nick_name FROM task t -- 关联负责人 LEFT JOIN task_user owner_tu ON owner_tu.task_id = t.id AND owner_tu.task_role = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user owner_su ON owner_su.user_id = owner_tu.user_id AND owner_su.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = 0 -- 用户是任务的参与者（负责人或协作人） AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_user tu WHERE tu.task_id = t.id AND tu.user_id = #{userId} ) -- 优化查询逻辑：显示所有未完成任务 + 当月已完成的任务 AND ( -- 未完成的任务（状态 0,1,2,3）全部显示 t.status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) OR -- 已完成的任务（状态 4）只显示当月完成的 (t.status = 4 AND t.update_time BETWEEN #{monthStart} AND #{monthEnd}) ) ORDER BY -- 优先级排序：未完成任务在前，已完成任务在后 CASE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, -- 按优先级降序（紧急优先） t.priority DESC, -- 按计划开始时间升序 t.plan_start_time ASC, -- 最后按创建时间降序 t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time, -- 计算是否逾期： -- 1. 没有计划结束时间：不算逾期 -- 2. 已完成（status=4）：比较实际完成时间(end_time)和计划结束时间 -- 3. 未完成：比较当前时间和计划结束时间 CASE WHEN t.plan_end_time IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN CASE WHEN t.end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.end_time > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END WHEN NOW() > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_overdue, t.remark, -- 负责人信息（taskRole = 1 表示负责人） owner_su.user_id AS owner_user_id, owner_su.avatar AS owner_avatar, owner_su.nick_name AS owner_nick_name FROM task t -- 关联负责人 LEFT JOIN task_user owner_tu ON owner_tu.task_id = t.id AND owner_tu.task_role = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user owner_su ON owner_su.user_id = owner_tu.user_id AND owner_su.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.del_flag = 0 -- 用户是任务的参与者（负责人或协作人） AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task_user tu WHERE tu.task_id = t.id AND tu.user_id = #{userId} ) -- 指定状态过滤（与 selectCurrentMonthTaskList 的唯一差异） AND t.status = #{status} -- 优化查询逻辑：显示所有未完成任务 + 当月已完成的任务（与 selectCurrentMonthTaskList 保持一致） AND ( -- 未完成的任务（状态 0,1,2,3）全部显示 t.status IN (0, 1, 2, 3) OR -- 已完成的任务（状态 4）只显示当月完成的 (t.status = 4 AND t.update_time BETWEEN #{monthStart} AND #{monthEnd}) ) ORDER BY -- 优先级排序：未完成任务在前，已完成任务在后 CASE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, -- 按优先级降序（紧急优先） t.priority DESC, -- 按计划开始时间升序 t.plan_start_time ASC, -- 最后按创建时间降序 t.create_time DESC

SELECT su.user_id AS userId, su.avatar AS avatar, su.nick_name AS nickName FROM task_user tu INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = tu.user_id AND su.del_flag = 0 WHERE tu.task_id = #{id} AND tu.task_role = 2 ORDER BY tu.create_time ASC

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time, -- 计算是否逾期： -- 1. 没有计划结束时间：不算逾期 -- 2. 已完成（status=4）：比较实际完成时间(end_time)和计划结束时间 -- 3. 未完成：比较当前时间和计划结束时间 CASE WHEN t.plan_end_time IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN CASE WHEN t.end_time IS NOT NULL AND t.end_time > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END WHEN NOW() > t.plan_end_time THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_overdue, t.remark, -- 负责人信息（taskRole = 1 表示负责人） owner_su.user_id AS owner_user_id, owner_su.avatar AS owner_avatar, owner_su.nick_name AS owner_nick_name FROM task t -- 关联负责人 LEFT JOIN task_user owner_tu ON owner_tu.task_id = t.id AND owner_tu.task_role = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user owner_su ON owner_su.user_id = owner_tu.user_id AND owner_su.del_flag = 0 WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY -- 按状态排序：未完成任务在前 CASE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, -- 按优先级降序（紧急优先） t.priority DESC, -- 按计划开始时间升序 t.plan_start_time ASC, -- 最后按创建时间降序 t.create_time DESC
